extras.title: A flower for your hair
extras.says: Frau Keller: “Finally, a young person with standards.”

extras.title: Knitted beanie
extras.says: Marta knitted it on night shifts. One side is longer. That's the charm.

extras.title: Brandt Bau cap
extras.says: Rolf: “Free advertising. I should be charging you.” He charges you.

extras.title: Stripy scarf
extras.says: Leni picked the colours. All of them.

extras.title: Sunglasses
extras.says: Kai: “Insane look. Insane.” You look like a vlogger. Dieter looks away.

extras.title: Bow tie
extras.says: Mayor Pfennig: “A future politician, I see.” He means it as a threat.
